tasks.title: Bind disposable validation to a verified push-disabled sandbox
criteria: AC15: Broken-build dynamic validation operates only in a disposable review copy: the pinned checkout/ref and remote remain unchanged, no push occurs, sandbox delta is evidence, and final output distinguishes submitted-PR from sandbox outcomes.

tasks.title: Confine artifact roots and return stable unavailable results for unsafe paths
criteria: AC12: Publishing a provisional or canonical revision automatically writes JSON, Markdown, and HTML containing complete DoR, criterion evidence, slot/lens status, all findings, dynamic evidence, collection/provenance, and gate state; a 120-finding round trip proves semantic equality and identical counts without a prompt.

tasks.title: Make leased producer-summary repair collectable or rerun only the affected slot
criteria: AC9: The observed valid fail/one-finding frontend result with unresolved free-form declaration identity is mechanically repaired from leased authority and collected without substantive rerun; changed findings, evidence, target, producer, slot, or unverifiable identity cannot be repaired and rerun only the affected slot.
AC10: Mixed-result retries invoke only affected producers; valid slots are neither re-reviewed nor rewritten, collection is idempotent, and final canonical output contains no duplicated findings.

tasks.title: Compose DoR, session, recovery, artifacts, and bounded inline pages into the production transaction
criteria: AC1: The same pinned PR, requirements, options, and deterministic lens fixtures on Claude and Codex produce semantically equivalent DoR, routing, leases, validation, findings, collection, gate, and JSON/Markdown/HTML results, with only transport metadata differing.

AC2: Fixtures for PR title/body/comments, commits, changelog, linked issue/spec/acceptance text, and repository contracts prove every available source is checked before routing with identity and revision provenance; missing, inaccessible, contradictory, and stale sources are explicit.

AC3: Paraphrase, bullet, prose, commit, changelog, comment, conflict, and non-requirement fixtures are dynamically classified as objective, acceptance criterion, review directive, constraint, or context; one clarification occurs only when ambiguity materially changes review.

AC4: Every extracted criterion is rendered as pass, fail, unproven, or not-applicable with rationale, evidence reference, verification method, and responsible lens/step; unproven or unjustified not-applicable prevents approval.

AC5: Semantic variants of security, bugs, usability, scale performance, quality, and architecture directives route applicable catalog lenses separately from feature acceptance criteria and do not silently suppress executable validation.

AC6: One complete-review choice covering all then-known non-destructive options reaches the final human gate without repeated render, dynamic, collection, repair, retry, or artifact approvals, and free-form equivalent consent works without an exact phrase.

AC7: A new approval is requested only for changed target/scope, newly destructive/external action, permission/credential escalation, unsafe operation, irreconcilable requirement ambiguity, or final disposition, and names the new fact and authority needed.

AC8: With zero, one, several, or all invalid/missing slots, valid findings remain in an immutable provisional revision with per-slot reasons, explicit incompleteness, disabled approval, stable provenance, and later supersession into a canonical revision.

AC11: On both hosts, inline interaction tests prove target/revision, DoR status/sources, expandable criterion evidence, lens status, severity/lens/file findings with rationale/action, dynamic evidence, provisional gaps, provenance, gate reason, filtering, keyboard navigation, and action receipts; approval controls are enabled only for complete approvable revisions.

AC13: Reviews at least as large as 126 KiB Markdown and 342 KiB HTML plus multi-megabyte fixtures dispatch every selected slot, retain every finding in exports, render inline by bounded pages/references, and preserve one revision/provenance across pages without making dashboard bytes producer input.

AC14: Host limitation, unavailable dynamic check, invalid reference, renderer failure, artifact-write failure, and unrepaired-slot injection produce stable actionable non-success states and never zero findings, declined-user-choice, completed review, or pass.

AC16: Existing complete small-review goldens retain routing, findings, gates, and artifact consumers unchanged or through an explicit versioned migration, with no test removal, skip, xfail, lowered floor, or weakened governance assertion.
